Water Filtration & Treatment

Whole-house filtration, softeners and conditioning tuned to Midlands water.

Get a Quote Call 803-600-4357

What It Is

Water treatment improves the water coming into your home. Depending on what's in it, that may mean a whole-house filter, a softener for hard water, or a drinking water system at the kitchen sink.

Signs You Need It

  • Spots and scale on fixtures and glass
  • Chlorine taste or smell
  • Dry skin or dull laundry
  • Sediment or discoloration in the water

What To Expect

We look at your water and how you use it, then recommend the system that fits. Installation includes connecting it to your plumbing, setting it up, and showing you any routine upkeep.

Residential Services

What We Handle

  • Whole-House Filtration

    A whole-house filter treats water where it enters the home, so every faucet and shower benefits. It can reduce sediment, chlorine and other common issues.

    What's included

    • System selection for your water
    • Installation at the main line
    • Bypass valve for servicing
    • Startup and filter change guidance

    Common signs you need this

    • Sediment in faucet screens
    • Chlorine smell in the shower
    • Discolored water
    Get a Quote

  • Water Softeners

    Hard water leaves scale on fixtures, inside water heaters and in your pipes. A softener removes the minerals that cause it.

    What's included

    • Softener sizing for your household
    • Installation and drain connection
    • Initial setup and programming
    • Upkeep walkthrough

    Common signs you need this

    • White scale on shower heads and glass
    • Soap that won't lather
    • Spots on dishes
    Get a Quote

  • Drinking Water Systems

    A system at the kitchen sink gives you cleaner water for drinking and cooking. It's a simple way to improve the water you use most.

    What's included

    • Under-sink system installation
    • Dedicated drinking water faucet
    • Connection to your supply line
    • Filter change guidance

    Common signs you need this

    • Buying bottled water for taste
    • Unpleasant taste or odor at the tap
    Get a Quote

  • Water Quality Check

    The right treatment depends on what's in your water. We look at what you're seeing at the tap and recommend a system based on it.

    What's included

    • Review of taste, odor and staining issues
    • Questions about your water source and usage
    • System recommendations
    • Clear explanation of options

    Common signs you need this

    • Not sure what kind of treatment you need
    • Moving into a new home or onto well water
    Get a Quote
